payload.text: (hv, 2026-11-10, first-hand in prose in vc's session, read by 08:48Z on vc's date -u) THE TREE HOLDS ONLY WHAT IS LIVE OR TO BE DONE. hv, verbatim: "We _should_ tidy things up. If issues and ST/WPs are resolved, then lets clean them out of the tree now. We should only have stuff that is live or to be done, old stuff can be dehydrated." So a resolved artefact's realised files leave the tree, by `intent organize --apply` once its whole preview has been read. vc's reading of the boundary: a Not Started thread is to be done and stays, listed with `intent st hydrate` before the apply; ST0056 and ST0057 are Completed and stay, because tests, the reference docs and the pre-commit guards read their files, until ST0084 relocates them; and before an apply every authored file in the removal list is checked byte for byte against tracked canon. First done on 2026-11-10: 41 closed-issue views and the trees of ST0081, ST0086 and ST0087. Closing an issue or completing a thread unlists it and leaves its files, and no step of a fold reconciles the tree, so views had gathered since 2026-10-23. This replaces the practice of 2026-10-25, when an apply's closed-issue removals were put back as an accident.
